evidence.summary: The formal candidate matched its approved sealed artifact, rights authority, exact file inventory, candidate digest, custom 404, and source release identity.

The authenticated paginated API lane recorded private visibility, exact main head, complete branch and tree inventory, no Pages/environment/gh-pages, and zero repository secret or variable metadata entries.
Authenticated repository readback confirmed public visibility, main as default branch, exact head 51411f59828748427e612b54a312e7346213d637, and the complete non-truncated tree.
The authenticated post-visibility API lane matched repository identity, public visibility, exact main head, branch/tree inventory, workflows, and the expected pre-Pages control-plane baseline.
An unauthenticated GitHub API read confirmed the expected public repository identity, main head 51411f59828748427e612b54a312e7346213d637, and a complete non-truncated 166-entry tree.

known_clones_and_cached_views.note: The audit records known project-owned surfaces but does not claim that every clone or cache is absent.

limitations.statement: No evidence in this bounded audit proves that all external copies or caches are absent; that intentional limitation is non-blocking.

unknown_external_copies.note: The audit is bounded to the sealed candidate and authenticated/anonymous repository readbacks; unknown external copies are not a zero gate.

zero_gate.reason: Known content, rights, byte identity, and provider state can be gated without claiming global absence of external copies.

checks: default branch head and complete tree
anonymous repository response matches the approved visibility state
branches, workflows, rulesets, environments, Pages and Actions settings
relevant repository lists paginated to exhaustion
public repository identity, visibility, default branch and head commit
authenticated API readback matches the visibility transition
anonymous API readback matches the expected public repository
rights disposition for every published unit

summary: The bounded first-launch audit verified the approved sealed candidate and content/rights inventory, recorded the authenticated private repository state before the authorized visibility change, and read back the public repository through authenticated and anonymous lanes. No launch-blocking content, rights, repository, or control-plane finding was observed. Pages deployment QA is intentionally outside this audit.
